method: Computed FY2025 revenue concentration from workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line joined to workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice at customer level, with parent-group sensitivity using workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer. evidence.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT i.customer_id AS k, SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS rev FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date)) = 2025 GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(100 * MAX(rev) / SUM(rev), 2) AS computed_value FROM r

WITH r AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, i.customer_id) AS k, COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) AS customer_name, SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS rev FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer p ON c.parent_customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date)) = 2025 GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT k AS customer_id, customer_name, ROUND(rev,2) AS revenue_usd FROM r ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(27.44 - 10.0, 1) AS variance_pp

method: Computed FY2025 NRR from workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month using the prior-year December cohort and December 2025 ending ARR. Primary value used parent-group consolidation through workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer; customer-level sensitivity was lower at 100.52%.

evidence.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_id, SUM(arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month f JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE snapshot_month = DATE '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0 GROUP BY 1), e AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_id, SUM(arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month f JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE snapshot_month = DATE '2025-12-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(COALESCE(e.arr_usd, 0)) / SUM(s.arr_usd), 2) AS nrr_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(e.arr_usd, 0), s.arr_usd)) / SUM(s.arr_usd), 2) AS grr_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.arr_usd, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned_logos, COUNT(*) AS cohort_logos, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.arr_usd, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS logo_churn_pct FROM s LEFT JOIN e ON s.group_id = e.group_id

WITH s AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = DATE '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), e AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = DATE '2025-12-01') SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(COALESCE(e.arr_usd, 0)) / SUM(s.arr_usd), 2) AS nrr_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(e.arr_usd, 0), s.arr_usd)) / SUM(s.arr_usd), 2) AS grr_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.arr_usd, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned_logos, COUNT(*) AS cohort_logos, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.arr_usd, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS logo_churn_pct FROM s LEFT JOIN e ON s.customer_id = e.customer_id

method: Computed FY2025 recurring revenue two ways from workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line, workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice, and workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product. Primary value used restated subscription evidence from delivery_model plus non-null service_period_start; management-tagged recurring share was materially higher at 98.34%.

evidence.sql: WITH revenue_tagged AS ( SELECT SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(il.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(il.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' THEN il.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' AND il.service_period_start IS NOT NULL THEN il.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS restated_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(il.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(il.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND NOT (LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' AND il.service_period_start IS NOT NULL) THEN il.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_failing_restate_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(il.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(il.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND NOT (LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' AND il.service_period_start IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_failing_restate_lines FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON il.product_id = p.product_id WHERE YEAR(to_date(i.invoice_date)) = 2025 ) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * tagged_revenue / total_revenue, 2) AS as_tagged_value, ROUND(100.0 * restated_revenue / total_revenue, 2) AS computed_value, ROUND(tagged_failing_restate_amount,2) AS tagged_failing_restate_amount, tagged_failing_restate_lines FROM revenue_tagged
SELECT ROUND(87.4 - 94.0, 1) AS variance_pp

what_would_raise_confidence: Executed order-form or product policy evidence defining which revenue_type tags should count as recurring despite missing subscription delivery evidence.

method: Management's FY2025 bridge in workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment reconciled to 12400000.0, but the team-supported adjusted EBITDA from ebitda_bridge.json was 5460000.0. Margin computed against SQL-derived FY2025 revenue was 12.8% on team EBITDA versus 29.0% on management EBITDA, not the claimed 32%.

evidence.sql: WITH fy25 AS ( SELECT adjustment_id, CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) AS amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025' ), bridge AS ( SELECT CAST(4280000 AS DOUBLE) AS reported_ebitda_usd, SUM(amount_usd) AS management_adjustments_total_usd FROM fy25 ) SELECT reported_ebitda_usd, management_adjustments_total_usd, reported_ebitda_usd + management_adjustments_total_usd AS mgmt_adjusted_ebitda_usd FROM bridge

WITH accepted AS ( SELECT * FROM VALUES ('ADJ-003', 0.0D), ('ADJ-004', 0.0D), ('ADJ-005', 0.0D), ('ADJ-006', 870000.0D), ('ADJ-007', 0.0D), ('ADJ-009', 310000.0D), ('ADJ-010', 0.0D) AS accepted(adjustment_id, accepted_amount_usd) ), mgmt AS ( SELECT adjustment_id, CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) AS amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025' ) SELECT CAST(4280000 AS DOUBLE) + SUM(a.accepted_amount_usd) AS team_adjusted_ebitda_usd FROM mgmt m LEFT JOIN accepted a ON m.adjustment_id = a.adjustment_id
SELECT ROUND(100 * 5460000.0 / 42730073.29, 1) AS computed_margin_pct
SELECT ROUND(100 * 12400000.0 / 42730073.29, 1) AS management_margin_pct

method: Computed FY2025 receivables performance from workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection joined to workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice using invoice-value-weighted days outstanding as the primary measure and simple average as a secondary measure. Quarterly weighted days moved from 63.4 in Q1 to 53.8 in Q4, but the annual weighted result of 66.8 was far above the claimed 45 days.

evidence.sql: WITH y AS (SELECT ROUND(SUM(c.days_outstanding * i.invoice_amount_usd) / SUM(i.invoice_amount_usd), 1) AS weighted_days, ROUND(AVG(c.days_outstanding),1) AS avg_days FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection c JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON c.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date)) = 2025) SELECT weighted_days AS computed_value, avg_days FROM y

WITH q AS (SELECT concat(year(to_date(i.invoice_date)), '-Q', quarter(to_date(i.invoice_date))) AS q, ROUND(AVG(c.days_outstanding), 1) AS avg_days, ROUND(SUM(c.days_outstanding * i.invoice_amount_usd) / SUM(i.invoice_amount_usd), 1) AS weighted_days FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection c JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON c.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date)) = 2025 GROUP BY 1) SELECT * FROM q ORDER BY q
SELECT ROUND(100 * (66.8 - 45.0) / 45.0, 1) AS variance_pct

evidence.sql: WITH top10 AS ( WITH rev AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd, MIN(c.first_order_date) AS group_first_order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(il.line_amount_usd) DESC, COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id)) AS rn FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE YEAR(to_date(i.invoice_date)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) ) SELECT * FROM rev WHERE rn <= 10 ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(datediff(DATE '2025-12-31', to_date(group_first_order_date)) / 365.25), 2) AS computed_value FROM top10

WITH top10 AS ( WITH rev AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd, MIN(COALESCE(cp.first_order_date, c.first_order_date)) AS group_first_order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(il.line_amount_usd) DESC, COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id)) AS rn FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer cp ON c.parent_customer_id = cp.customer_id WHERE YEAR(to_date(i.invoice_date)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) ) SELECT * FROM rev WHERE rn <= 10 ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(datediff(DATE '2025-12-31', to_date(group_first_order_date)) / 365.25), 2) AS group_level_value FROM top10
